attributes.title: Slides
attributes.lede: Three compositions. The same four things.

lesson.why: A shared plate and repeated text keep identity between slides while slide-specific copy enters and leaves. The plate is sized as a real box so its gradient does not stretch with a snapshot.
lesson.experiment: Move forward, reverse mid-transition, and compare the plate edge with the departing sentence. Try Elastic typography and Editorial snap.
lesson.pitfall: Giving every slide a wholly unrelated identity turns a meaningful rearrangement into disconnected entrances.
lesson.combine: Combine with presentation gates for click-paced reveals within a slide.
